description:
Add an OrphanWatchdog to the entry point so the BEAM exits if the host crashes or leaks the stdin pipe FD.

**Why:** MCP stdio servers normally exit when the host closes stdin (EOF). If the host crashes or leaks the pipe FD, EOF never arrives and the server zombies on `IO.read/2`, holding ports/sockets/PTYs open until manually killed.

**Pattern (canonical):** see `AtlasMCP.OrphanWatchdog` in `/Users/mz/dev/mz/atlas/mcp/server.exs` and `SlackMcp.OrphanWatchdog` in `/Users/mz/dev/mz/slack-mcp/server.exs`. Spawns a background process that polls `ps -o ppid= -p <self>` every 5s and `System.halt(0)`s if reparented (PID 1 / launchd, or anything other than the boot-time parent).

**How to apply:**
1. Copy the OrphanWatchdog module verbatim, adjusting the namespace + Log reference.
2. In the entry point, after Process.flag(:trap_exit, true) but before/around other startup work, capture initial PPID via OrphanWatchdog.current_ppid() and start the watchdog if non-nil. Match atlas/slack-mcp wording for the log lines.

**Acceptance:**
- Module exists, mirrors the atlas template.
- Entry point starts the watchdog and logs "Orphan watchdog armed (parent PID N)" on success or "Could not determine parent PID; orphan watchdog disabled" on failure.
- Existing tests still pass.
title: Add OrphanWatchdog (mirror atlas/slack-mcp)
